arguments.code:
eligible = [(p['product_id'], p['quantity'], p['rating']) for p in wish_list if p.get('rating') is not None and p.get('rating')>3.7]
print('eligible', eligible)
orig_qty = {pid: qty for pid, qty, _ in eligible}
print('orig_qty', orig_qty)

results=[]
for pid, qty, rating in eligible:
    resp = apis.amazon.move_product_from_wish_list_to_cart(product_id=pid, access_token=amazon_token, quantity=qty)
    print('moved', pid, 'qty', qty, 'rating', rating, 'resp', resp)
    results.append((pid,qty,rating,resp))
print('move_results_count', len(results))

cart = apis.amazon.show_cart(access_token=amazon_token)
print('cart_total_cost', cart.get('total_cost'))
cart_items = cart.get('cart_items', [])
print('cart_items_len', len(cart_items))
cart_summary=[(it.get('product_id'), it.get('product_name'), it.get('quantity'), it.get('price')) for it in cart_items]
print('cart_summary', cart_summary)

wish_after = apis.amazon.show_wish_list(access_token=amazon_token)
print('wish_after_len', len(wish_after))
wish_ids_qty=[(p.get('product_id'), p.get('quantity')) for p in wish_after]
print('wish_after_ids_qty', wish_ids_qty)

eligible_ids_set=set(orig_qty.keys())
cart_qty_map={it.get('product_id'): it.get('quantity') for it in cart_items}
wish_qty_map={p.get('product_id'): p.get('quantity') for p in wish_after}

print('eligible_ids_set', eligible_ids_set)
print('in_cart', {pid: cart_qty_map.get(pid) for pid in eligible_ids_set})
print('in_wish', {pid: wish_qty_map.get(pid) for pid in eligible_ids_set})

criteria1 = all(cart_qty_map.get(pid)==orig_qty[pid] for pid in eligible_ids_set)
criteria2 = all(pid not in wish_qty_map for pid in eligible_ids_set)
print('criteria1_all_qty_match', criteria1)
print('criteria2_removed_from_wish', criteria2)
